Then we need to lock them if any are unlocked. The lockDoors function takes unlock boolean and door array. If we want to lock, we set unlock false. We need to specify which doors. We could call displayCarStatus to see status. But the function returns something? It likely prints or returns status. We can just call it. Then we call lockDoors with unlock false and door list all four. That ensures they are locked. That might lock already locked doors again but that's fine.

Thus we need to call displayCarStatus with option "doors" then lockDoors with unlock false and door list all four.
